# BigQuery Data Analytics

Skills that teach agents to work with BigQuery Data Analytics. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [gemini-cli-extensions/bigquery-data-analytics](https://github.com/gemini-cli-extensions/bigquery-data-analytics), at commit `6f9b356`.

Connect, query, and generate data insights for BigQuery datasets and data.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **BigQuery Data Analytics**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **BigQuery Data Analytics**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install bigquery-data-analytics@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

1 skill: `bigquery-ai-ml`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/gemini-cli-extensions/bigquery-data-analytics
